One count per stock per day — your rule: "make sure you are not accounting for duplicates of the same stock as winner unless it did the same pattern again and met all the criteria on the same day". A name that rang again the same day is listed and chipped, never counted twice, unless the later ring set up again: its own fill minute, its own trigger and stop, and a trade of its own, not one held while the first was still running. A duplicate stays out of every count, % and chart.

track_record.rule_text: Fill = the first 1-minute bar at least 30 s after the alert trading at or above the trigger, from the regular open — the same fill convention as 🚩's 🏁 (a Cheetah choice, for comparability). Stop = the alert's stop, a touch. Exit = the stop or the first daily close below the 9 EMA, whichever prints first — his stated exit (VKNEJA5r8zw 2:29:17). His partials at 3R and 5R are shown as flags, not applied (HIS CALL #5); no maximum hold — a row stays open until the exit prints (HIS CALL #11). The alert itself can print up to 5 minutes after his bar closed (one Luk pass per 5 minutes), so a 🏁 fill is later than his would have been — a fact (HIS CALL #29).
